test_title: PYST 24: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven friends, A, B, C, D, P, Q and R, are sitting in a straight line facing north. Only two people sit to the left of R. Only three people sit between R and P. Only one person sits between P and A. D sits to the immediate left of Q. B is not an immediate neighbour of P. How many people sit to the right of C?
solution:
**Given:** Seven friends, A, B, C, D, P, Q and R, are sitting in a straight line facing north. 

1) Only two people sit to the left of R.

2) Only three people sit between R and P. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81b8036e6f2d303459867d531aaee9a5d896e565be95e3251b1f738c17416fbe.png] 

3) Only one person sits between P and A.

4) D sits to the immediate left of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7fe71806202073f130fe54d6df7365b9d6c56d398d6a98c9289a38c93a7752a3.png] 

5) B is not an immediate neighbour of P.

After positioning B only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef0afda96f99eabf38f1abbb5192eab5e4df3c6662800c3e0b6738321a85cfd9.png] 

Thus, one person sit to the right of C.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
